{"idea":"Use the subtraction hypothesis to express m as n + 2. If m is below or above 18, bound both factors and contradict their product being 288.","proof":"  have hle : n ≤ m := by
    by_contra h
    have h' : m ≤ n := Nat.le_of_lt (Nat.lt_of_not_ge h)
    have hz : m - n = 0 := Nat.sub_eq_zero_of_le h'
    rw [h₂] at hz
    norm_num at hz
  have heq : m = n + 2 := by
    have hcancel := Nat.sub_add_cancel hle
    rw [h₂] at hcancel
    linarith
  by_contra hne
  rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne hne with hlt | hgt
  · have hm : m ≤ 17 := by linarith
    have hn : n ≤ 15 := by linarith
    have hp : m * n ≤ 17 * 15 := Nat.mul_le_mul hm hn
    norm_num at hp
    linarith
  · have hm : 19 ≤ m := by linarith
    have hn : 17 ≤ n := by linarith
    have hp : 19 * 17 ≤ m * n := Nat.mul_le_mul hm hn
    norm_num at hp
    linarith","insight_statement":"m = n + 2","insight_proof":"  have hle : n ≤ m := by
    by_contra h
    have h' : m ≤ n := Nat.le_of_lt (Nat.lt_of_not_ge h)
    have hz : m - n = 0 := Nat.sub_eq_zero_of_le h'
    rw [h₂] at hz
    norm_num at hz
  have hcancel := Nat.sub_add_cancel hle
  rw [h₂] at hcancel
  linarith"}
